figures.caption: FIG. 1: Phenomenology of steady-states in the memorization phase t ≫ Tht, for Tst = Tht ≫ 1. (Left) Phase diagram with a. Plain chaos (grey), b. Semi-freezable chaos (pink), c. Freezable chaos (green), d. Semi-freezable limit cycle (orange) and e. Freezable limit cycle (blue). The red dotted line denotes the transition from chaotic dynamics to limit cycle activity during the periodic stimulation (t < Tst). (Middle and Right) Steady-state behavior of C(t, t′) and Y (t, t′) in the memorization phase (t ≥ t′ ≫ Tht). Color shadings correspond to different values of t′.

FIG. 2: Comparison between DMFT and finite-size numerical simulations in the memorization phase. The left and middle panels show results for the dynamical system Eq. (1), while the right panel is obtained with the SCS model. C(t, t′) as obtained from numerical simulations with N neurons and averaged over Ns disorder realizations converges slowly as N increases to its DMFT prediction (Top-left). This is due to sample-to-sample fluctuations in the period T ∗ of the oscillations in C(t, t′), which result in destructive interference (Bottom-left). (Middle) Numerical simulations with N = 1024 neurons in the memorization phase t ≥ t′ ≫ Tht with I = 2, k = 2.5. Traces of neuronal activities xi(t) (top) and sample-to-sample behavior of C(t, t′) (bottom) are shown. The dark curve is averaged over Ns realizations of disorder. (Right) Same as middle panels but for ϕi(t) and Cϕϕ(t, t ′) = 1 N ∑ i ϕi(t)ϕi(t ′) in the SCS model. Parameters for the SCS model are: g = 1.5, p = 15, ω = 0.6, I = 2, k = 3. For both models, Ns = 1000.

FIG. 3: (Left) Lifetime of persistent oscillations for t ≥ Tst with active plasticity (Tht → ∞). The lifetime Tlt is defined as the time interval over which C(t, Tst), plotted as a function of t− Tst, displays sustained oscillations. Numerically, Tlt is obtained by locating the point after the final oscillation peak where |∂tC(t, Tst)| falls below a fixed threshold. (Right) Impact of a non-zero metabolic phase ∆me = Tht − Tst on the limit cycle attractor of the memorization phase (t ≥ t′ ≫ Tht). As long as ∆me is sufficiently small compared to Tlt, the MSD vanishes periodically, indicating limit cycle activity (shades of viridis). Parameters are: I = 2, k = 3.5.
